text:
Anika: Quick thread to capture follow-ups from today's all-hands about customer wins/losses. Please drop one-line bullets (why we won / why we lost, top asks) so we can action.
Priya: From sales — lost a fintech pilot. Main reasons: missing SSO/SAML + pricing mismatch for pilot scope. They asked for private VPC + longer log retention. @Tomas can you confirm CS follow-up? :frowning:
Tomas: Confirmed. We logged the loss and have a follow-up call scheduled. Customer loved our latency but needed SOC2 + audit-ready logs; timeline was unclear for them so they paused. Moving them to a 30d nurture cadence.
Marco: Roadmap note: we have backlog items for enterprise auth and audit logs but not prioritized. Requesting prioritization: 1) SAML/SCIM, 2) audit log export (immutable), 3) sample SLA language. These will unblock multiple deals.
Darren: From eng infra: SAML + audit logs are straightforward feature-wise but need ~2 sprints + e2e test harness and secure key rotation flow. Also need better token-level tracing for debugging customer incidents.
Beth: Research insight: a few losses cited model hallucinations on domain-specific prompts. Suggest we add targeted eval suites and automatic regression alerts tied to key prompt sets.
Priya: Wins to call out: 3 orgs committed to Dedicated because of throughput/latency guarantees + predictable billing. They specifically referenced the "predictable billing" one-pager we shared. We should standardize that asset.
Anika: Leadership: agree on priorities — SAML/SCIM and audit logs top enterprise asks. Marco + Darren, can you scope and post rough timelines by EOD Friday? Tomas + Priya, list top 5 prospects/customers asking for these features in that doc.
Marco: Will scope. Also will add a sample SLA template to the doc for legal to quick-review.
Tomas: Action: I'll create a shared doc, tag affected customers, and run a short win/loss survey for churned pilots to capture finer signals.
Darren: One ask from infra: need typical customer data volumes for dedicated capacity requests so we can model capacity/cost and pre-warm pools. If sales can attach rough sizes that'd help.
Beth: I'll assemble a small prompt set for hallucination regressions and propose an alert threshold. Adding to Redwood Optimize backlog.
Priya: Suggest a quick GTM playbook: "Why we win" one-pager (latency SLA, cost predictability, predictable capacity, security options) for AE/SEs. Short, 1 page.
Anika: Good — @Priya lead the playbook with marketing. Product & ENG will support with backstop claims and numbers.
all-hands-bot: Meeting notes uploaded — https://redwood.company/notes/allhands-1765009876
Anika: Closing — we'll reconvene on this next week. If anyone else has signals (pricing pushback, specific feature asks), drop a 1-line note here. :thumbsup:
